Prelaunch website notice · 22 November 2026

1. Acceptance and eligibility

By using Hello Customer, an authorized business user accepts these terms. Businesses must be legally able to use the service and provide accurate registration information.

2. Account registration

Users are responsible for protecting account access and authorized use. Eligibility, verification and access can depend on service and provider requirements.

3. Customer data responsibilities

Businesses are responsible for lawful collection, accuracy, permission, consent records, opt-outs and instructions relating to customer data. Passwords, OTPs and complete card details must never be shared with support.

4. WhatsApp compliance and consent

Use must follow applicable WhatsApp Business Platform rules, template requirements, messaging limits, laws, recipient permission and opt-outs. Meta approval, account eligibility, template approval and uninterrupted delivery are not guaranteed.

5. Prohibited uses

Spam, deception, harassment, impersonation, unlawful content, unauthorized access, scraping, restriction evasion and prohibited goods or services are not allowed.

6. Third-party services

Meta, payment, hosting and other services operate independently under their terms. Their availability and decisions may affect Hello Customer.

7. AI-generated content

AI-assisted features are planned. Users must review outputs for accuracy, legality and suitability; generated content and business results are not guaranteed.

8. Subscription charges and trial

Hello Customer has one software subscription at ₹399 per month and a one-month trial for eligible new businesses. WhatsApp messaging charges are separate. This prelaunch website does not activate trials or accept payment.

9. Renewal and cancellation

Recurring charges require appropriate authorization and clear disclosure. Once enabled, cancellation stops future renewals; it is separate from refund requests and account deletion. Already-paid access may continue to period end unless an eligible refund or other condition applies.

10. Refund eligibility

A payment may be eligible for refund only when requested within five calendar days of the relevant payment and no campaign was run in that paid period. Mandatory statutory rights remain unaffected.

11. Restrictions and availability

Accounts may be restricted for security, non-payment, unlawful activity, policy breaches or provider limitations. Service availability, messaging delivery and third-party approvals are not guaranteed.

12. Intellectual property

Hello Customer, its original content, software and brand assets belong to their respective owners. Meta and WhatsApp marks belong to their owners.

13. Data protection

Information is handled under the Privacy Policy. Businesses must have authority for the customer data they provide.

14. Liability and applicable law

To the extent allowed by applicable law, Hello Customer does not guarantee business outcomes and is not responsible for independent third-party service decisions. Applicable law and dispute terms require legal review before commercial launch.
